main_text.p: I. Lalsos doctores, perditas quandoque hæreses in Ecclesiam invecturos, & in consortium erroris perditionisque complures, per quos via veritatis blasphemabitur, tracturos, hac interalias nota Spiritus S. 2. Pet. II. 2 distinguit: ... Per avaritiam fictis sermonibus vos quæstui habebunt, vel negotiabuntur. Ficti illiFalsorum doctorum inter alias nota est, quod per avaritiam fictis sermonibus homines nundinantur.

page.notes: Large historiated initial E at start of the paragraph. Greek phrase after "distinguit" is partly illegible and is not transcribed. Marginal notes on the right are small and only partly legible. Page 499 printed top right.
